name: Centaur Bracers
summary: West of the Crossroads, Regthar Deathgate calls for Centaur Bracers. Kolkar centaurs contest the central Barrens, threatening Horde control of the plains.

sections.title: Securing the Plains
sections.body: The young Horde is fighting to secure territory across Kalimdor. The Barrens lie between Durotar and Mulgore, but Kolkar centaurs contest its watering holes and open plains. They attack supply trains and scouting parties. Regthar Deathgate, an orc warrior, directs the defense from his bunker west of the Crossroads.

sections.title: A Gruesome Accounting
sections.body: Regthar asks for proof that Kolkar warriors have fallen. Soldiers who enter Kolkar territory bring back bracers taken from slain centaurs. The trophies verify claims for Horde bounties and are meant to frighten surviving Kolkar raiders.

faq.answer: Regthar Deathgate is an orc commander in a fortified bunker west of the Crossroads. He leads the Horde's efforts to suppress centaur raiders across the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want centaur bracers?
faq.answer: Centaur bracers prove that enemy warriors were slain in the field. Regthar uses them to ensure bounties go only to those who inflict actual casualties on the hostile Kolkar tribes.

faq.q: Why are the Kolkar attacking the Horde?
faq.answer: The Kolkar are a brutal centaur clan native to central Kalimdor, and they seek to expand. They claim the Barrens as hunting grounds and fight the new settlements, camps, and alliances formed by orcs and tauren.

faq.q: Where are the Kolkar centaurs located in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Kolkar raiding camps lie around oases and rugged ridges across the central and southern Barrens. The centaurs often dispute access to water and routes through the region.

faq.q: Does collecting these bracers stop the Kolkar attacks?
faq.answer: No. Regthar hopes the losses will frighten surviving raiders, but he doubts the Kolkar will willingly stop their attacks.

faq.q: What is the strategic value of the Crossroads?
faq.answer: The Crossroads links Durotar, the tauren plains of Mulgore, and northern routes into Ashenvale. Defeating nearby centaur war parties helps keep Horde supply lines intact.

angles.text: Clearing Kolkar protects supply links between Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff.
As a tauren, you know the centaur have devastated and committed genocide against tauren tribes for centuries. Thinning their numbers in the Barrens is personal retribution.
As an orc, securing Durotar's borders against nomadic raiders helps establish a permanent, stable homeland.
